title: RPG Maker MZ - implementing stat drain when you are hit while guarding.

posts.author: IndividuallyWrapped
posts.body: I use MP as stamina, so each turn, the player recovers some MP. I want to make it so if they guard, and are hit while guarding, it drains some MP. I don't want this to happen if they are hit while not guarding, however.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
You'll need to use a plugin that allows you to attach code to a state.
If you're using VisuStella plugins, their Battle Core has notetags for it. If you're not, you can use my Eval Tags plugin, linked in my signature.
Using my Eval Tags, you'd give your Guard state the notetag:
Code:
<Action Respond Eval>
if (skill.isDamage())
    target.gainMp(-10);
</Action Respond Eval>
That will make you lose 10 MP every time you're hit while guarding. You can change the number or make it a formula inside the parentheses.
